description: Attributes are your character's core stats - the numbers that tell you how tough, sharp, and energetic they are. They answer basic questions like 'How healthy am I?' or 'Am I about to die?' To keep things simple and balanced, every character starts with six pre-set attributes.

attributes.name: Health
attributes.description: Your life meter. Shows how far you are from getting knocked out. Drops when hit. At 0, you start dying (1d4 damage/Turn until -10). Regain 1 Health/hour of rest, full recharge after Mission.

mechanics.damage: Lose Health when hit by enemy (Attack > Defense).
mechanics.stabilize: Regain at least 1 Health to stabilize.
mechanics.recovery: 1 Health/hour of rest, full after Mission.

attributes.example: Enemy hits for 4 damage. 25 Health → 21 Health.

attributes.name: Focus
attributes.description: Mental energy and concentration. Spend Focus to boost dice rolls, reroll, or achieve Instant Success. Recharges at 2 points/hour of rest, full after Mission.

mechanics.boost: +1 to any dice roll per Focus spent.
mechanics.reroll: Spend 2 Focus to reroll one die.
mechanics.recovery: 2 Focus/hour of rest, full after Mission.

attributes.example: Spend 2 Focus to boost Attack from 3 to 5, or reroll. Spend 5 Focus for Instant Success.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Physical energy. Spend Stamina for actions in combat. Refills every Turn.

maneuvers.name: Assess
maneuvers.description: Gather info. Roll Sense Action Dice vs. Risk Threshold.

maneuvers.name: Assist
maneuvers.description: Aid ally within 5m. 2 Stamina: +1 dice size. More Stamina = higher bonus.

maneuvers.name: Attack
maneuvers.description: Normal (3): Attack vs. Defense, roll damage. Quick (2): half damage. Heavy (5): double damage.

maneuvers.name: Concentrate
maneuvers.description: Increase next dice size. More Stamina = higher bonus. Can use defensively.

maneuvers.name: Defend
maneuvers.description: +1 to next Defense Dice per Stamina spent.

maneuvers.name: Distract
maneuvers.description: -1 to enemy's next Attack Dice per Stamina spent.

maneuvers.name: Hide
maneuvers.description: Conceal behind cover. Roll Finesse vs. Sense.

maneuvers.name: Inflict Condition
maneuvers.description: Impose negative condition, half damage. 3: mild, 4: moderate, 5: severe.

maneuvers.name: Interact
maneuvers.description: Explore, manipulate, or talk. Cost increases with complexity.

maneuvers.name: Move
maneuvers.description: Move up to 5m per Stamina spent.

maneuvers.name: Recover
maneuvers.description: Remove negative condition by rolling Action Dice.

maneuvers.name: Resuscitate
maneuvers.description: Stabilize dying ally. Roll Intellect vs. Risk Threshold.

special_moves.name: Jump
special_moves.description: Jump 1m. If moving 5m before, jump 2m per Stamina.

mechanics.pro_tip: Director may assign Stamina cost for unlisted actions (default: 3).

attributes.example: Start with 5 Stamina. Spend 2 to run 10m, 3 to attack. Out of Stamina, turn ends.

attributes.name: Reflex
attributes.description: Combat awareness and reaction. Spend Reflex for Interrupts on others' Turns. Leftover Stamina becomes Reflex. Restores at 1/hour.

mechanics.interrupt: Spend Reflex to act on another's Turn. Must directly respond to their action.
mechanics.combo: Allies can combine Reflex for coordinated actions.
mechanics.conversion: Leftover Stamina becomes Reflex after Turn.
mechanics.substitute: Any Stamina action can use Reflex during Interrupts.

attributes.example: Spend Reflex to dash and attack during enemy's Turn. Roll opposed dice to resolve.

attributes.name: Injury
attributes.description: Tracks lasting damage. Each time you drop to 0 Health but survive, gain 1 Injury. Each point reduces max Health by 5, Focus by 2. Every 2 Injury: -1 max Stamina/Reflex. Every 3 Injury: lose body part or sanity.

mechanics.gain: Gain 1 Injury when dropping to 0 Health and surviving.
mechanics.healing: Requires specialized medical care (Director sets cost).

body_injury_system.impact: Reduce Influence Dice by 3, permanently Blinded/Deafened/Muted (Director's discretion)
Reduce Intellect/Sense Dice by 3, cannot recover Reflex
Reduce Vitality Dice by 3, Stamina regen -50%
Reduce Strength Dice by 3, cannot dual-wield or use two-handed weapons
Cannot use Focus, panic attacks in high-stress situations

mechanics.director_note: Director determines body part affected at 3 Injury based on narrative. Multiple injuries possible as Injury increases.

attributes.example: Knocked out at 0 Health, stabilized by allies. Gain 1 Injury, max Health -5, max Focus -2 until healed.

attributes.name: Luck
attributes.description: Emergency button to change the story. Director can veto. Regenerates after Mission.

uses: Recover: Fully restore Health, Focus, Stamina, Reflex.
Critical: Turn attack into Critical Hit.
Maximize: Convert all damage to maximum value.
Succeed: Instantly succeed on a problem.

attributes.example: Use Luck to avoid trap, cure disease, or turn enemy into ally (Director approval required).
